title: Sessions: one folder per session, for good

chat.text: The 794 twin session folders were cleaned up, but two bugs that made them can still make new ones. This task fixes both bugs, gives every writer one shared way to find a session's folder, and adds a check that reports any session found in two folders.

message.text: Ready to merge. Every program that writes session records now asks one shared lookup, SessionFolders, which session folder to use, so a session can't get a second folder from either cause again. A daily check warns the day one appears anyway. The 1,408 duplicate folders already there were merged in a test run on a copy of their folders and lost 0 of 16,445 lines; the steps to do it for real are in the task log: /framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/session-twins-fix/ · how it works: /framework/ai/sessions/doc/one-folder.md
